purpose: Reviewer-requested sensitivity analysis of the MPDS retrieval-corpus size using nested OpenAlex evidence pools.

design.execution_order: Block-randomized by replicate, then shuffled over all case-by-corpus-size cells within each block.

generation.debate_knowledge_policy: The full selected top-N snapshot is supplied on each of that scientist's three debate turns, matching the submitted MPDS implementation.
fixed_factors: case-specific problem statement and user context
three debate rounds with two turns per round
model, backend, location, temperature, and output-token limit
generation.only_manipulated_factor: Number of relevance-ranked OpenAlex records retained per pool before the unchanged MPDS pipeline is run.

retrieval.required_filter: has_abstract:true plus the case-specific publication-date window
retrieval.nested_rule: For each case and pool, retrieve one ordered top-1000 master snapshot once; top-100, top-250, and top-500 are exact ordered prefixes of that master.

criteria: Cover distinct battery chemistries and both material-design and protocol-centered tasks.
Require at least 1000 abstract-bearing OpenAlex results in both evidence pools without broadening the submitted query or cutoff.
Avoid selecting multiple near-duplicate sodium-ion morphology tasks when a more diverse case is available.

selected_cases.stratum: manuscript Case Study 1 / sodium-ion anode / composition-process trade-off
lithium-selenium cathode / host confinement and shuttle suppression

documented_exclusion.reason: The unchanged pool-A query and 2015-2024 cutoff currently return only 782 abstract-bearing core OpenAlex works, so a genuine nested top-1000 condition cannot be constructed without altering the retrieval universe.

analysis_lock.unit: case mean across three stochastic replicates
analysis_lock.interpretation: Treat 500 papers as a practical operating point if quality plateaus by 500 while cost or runtime continues to increase; do not claim formal optimality from this four-case sensitivity experiment.
